title: Affine Lefschetz over a strictly localized finite-type trait model
statement:
Let $C$ be a complete discrete valuation ring, meaning a Noetherian local domain of dimension one with principal maximal ideal and complete for its powers [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Let $B$ be a scheme of finite type over $\operatorname{Spec}C$, let $\bar t$ be a geometric point of $B$, and put $T=B_{(\bar t)}$, its strict henselization [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Put $\delta_T(t)=\dim\overline{\{t\}}$, with closure in $T$ [def-per-geometric-dimension-function]. Fix a prime $\ell$ invertible on $T$, an affine morphism of finite type $f:Y\to T$, and a constructible sheaf $F$ of $\mathbf F_\ell$-modules on $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$ [pqf-def-affine-morphism, def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Define
$$\delta_Y(y)=\delta_T(f(y))+\operatorname{trdeg}_{\kappa(f(y))}\kappa(y),$$
where $\kappa$ denotes residue fields [def-weil-residue-field]. If an integer $b$ bounds $\delta_Y(y)$ at every point with nonzero geometric stalk $F_{\bar y}$, then
$$H^q(Y_{\mathrm{et}},F)=0\qquad(q\geq0,\ q>b),$$
taking cohomology of the underlying abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].
